entries.title: Qn+ pn= qpn

entries.key_innovation: Introduces queueing Petri nets that combine queueing networks and Petri nets using timed transitions and timeless queues to model scheduling and support efficient analysis.

entries.title: Integrating software and hardware performance models using hierarchical queeing petri nets
entries.key_innovation: Uses hierarchical queueing Petri nets to integrate software and hardware performance models.

entries.title: The palladio component model for model-driven performance prediction
entries.key_innovation: Introduces the Palladio Component Model for model-driven performance prediction of software architectures.

entries.title: Behavioral log analysis with statistical guarantees
entries.key_innovation: Treats behavioral log analysis as a statistical experiment, analyzing sampled traces to provide statistical correctness guarantees and address scalability.

entries.title: Multiple fault localiza-´ tion with data mining

entries.title: A model-driven approach for continuous performance engineering in microservice-based systems

entries.title: Performance mutation testing

entries.title: Enhancing performance prediction robustness by combining analytical modeling and machine learning
entries.key_innovation: Combines analytical modeling and machine learning to leverage AM's promptness and ML's accuracy, enhancing performance prediction robustness across explored and unexplored feature regions.

entries.title: Towards the use of the readily available tests from the release pipeline as performance tests

entries.title: An industrial case study on the automated detection of performance regressions in heterogeneous environments

entries.title: Identifying impactful service system problems via log analysis

entries.title: Automated root cause isolation of performance regressions during software development
